description: Wild battle vs Rattata; player has a full party of 6 (Charmander active, Caterpie, Pikachu, 3x Rattata), party-select screen already open ("Choose a POKeMON.") -- captured specifically to test the switch feature across multiple slots, not just a single alive/dead pair.
notes: battle_type confirmed via real RAM read (BattleContext.battle_type == WILD) at capture time, not just inferred from the screenshot (no trainer sprite shown, plain 'RATTATA :L3').
enemy/party Rattata types (Normal/Normal) are not shown on screen -- general game knowledge, same convention already used for Diglett/Sandshrew in battle_must_go_on_fight.json.
enemy.hp is not shown as an exact number on screen (health bar only, appeared full) -- the [15, 15] value here is confirmed via a real RAM read (BattleScene.to_dict()) at capture time, not guessed.
Charmander/Caterpie/Pikachu types (Fire/Bug/Electric) reused from battle_must_go_on_fight.json for the same species, not re-derived here -- the party-select screen doesn't show types.

Party slot 6 displays a hard-to-read name on screen that looked like a custom nickname -- confirmed via real RAM read that its SPECIES is Rattata (L3, 15/15 HP); PartyPokemon.name returns the species' English name, not any in-game nickname, so this is expected, not a discrepancy.
moves not captured for any Pokemon here -- neither screenshot shows a move list (the FIGHT menu was never opened, only PKMN).

menu_top=(9,14) menu_id=0 (FIGHT, ready_main_menu) at the moment this state was saved, confirmed via real RAM read -- the party-select screen itself is reached by driving from here, not baked into the save.
